name: Freshdi
description: Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace connecting suppliers and buyers across every industry. This connector lets Claude search the marketplace and take action on Freshdi on your behalf, directly from your conversation. You can search products and suppliers, browse categories, and discover buying requests (RFQs) posted by importers along with their full details. As a buyer, you can post your own buying request (RFQ) or send product inquiries to suppliers; as a supplier, you can respond to RFQs with quotations. Freshdi requires an account, and every action is performed as your authenticated user.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Freshdi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Freshdi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.freshdi.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Freshdi MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freshdi provides these MCP tools: create_inquiry, create_quotation, create_rfq, get_product_categories, get_rfq_detail, search_products, and search_rfqs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Freshdi?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Freshdi in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Freshdi requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Freshdi is developed by Freshdi. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
